name: beads-band
description: A band above the Claude Code prompt for beads (br) task queues: queue meter and stats when idle, the task this session claimed when working

beadsDir.title: Beads directory
beadsDir.description: Absolute path of the checkout whose .beads/ the band reads. Empty: the session's own directory

queueLabel.title: Queue label
queueLabel.description: Label marking tasks queued for automation; the meter counts ready tasks carrying it

queueCommand.title: Queue command (optional)
queueCommand.description: A command (run without a shell) that prints a JSON array of eligible tasks; overrides br ready --label <queueLabel>

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the band re-reads the queue in the background

targetMin.title: Queue target, low end
targetMin.description: Eligible count the meter has to reach

targetMax.title: Queue target, high end
targetMax.description: Eligible count that fills the meter
